subject: Social Media
title: Weak Ties Spread Further
description: A quick, practical guide to Weak Ties Spread Further.

hook.text: Your close friends know the same people you do. Your acquaintances know entirely different worlds.

buildup.text: Mark Granovetter's 1973 paper proved that weak ties—casual acquaintances—are bridges between clusters.

discovery.text: Most job referrals come through weak ties. Most viral content spreads through weak ties too.

twist.text: Social media massively increased weak ties. You're connected to thousands you barely know—ideal for virality.

climax.text: Strong ties share deeply. Weak ties share widely. For virality, breadth beats depth every time.

punchline.text: Acquaintances spread more than friends do.

quiz.question: Why are weak ties important for viral spread?
